about: UCG Masters scoring for MAG and WAG: digest of scoring.md. Own words. 'cite' is the section of the UCG Masters Rules Policy v2.1 draft (aligned with the international Masters Code of Points 2025-2028; source of record: the UCG Google Doc, see README; extract text/rules-policy.md, Drive version 1756). Level lists run 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s, 70s; a level is the lowest that qualifies (null: none). Planner: js/scoring/masters.js, mag.js, wag.js.

difficulty_by_decade.cite: §III.B.2 (MAG), §III.C.2 (WAG) tables: same values. GE = Gymnastics Element; the old label Misc. is retired (decisions.md)

categories.GE: Gymnastics Element: any gymnastics skill the judge accepts that is in neither the WG code nor the Masters CoP, down to a plain swing; a WG element not recognised for a short hold or angle may still count as a GE, one not recognised for a fall may not
categories.ME: Masters Element: below WG A, above GE; marked ME in the Masters CoPs (a few higher-valued MEs print their value)

counting_elements.cite: §III.B.2 table and c; §III.C.2 table and b

vault.springboard: hard or soft board from the host; adding or removing springs is a 0.5 neutral deduction

eg_bonus.eg_element_must_count: an element that fills an EG must be among the counting elements; the judge swaps out a higher-valued element if needed
eg_bonus.ge_eg: the judge assigns it; tell the judges when registering the routine

MAG.devaluations: unlisted straddled holds and straddled or bent-arm strength: one level lower; strength with swing or swing with strength: one level lower or at least GE (§III.B.2.e)

extra_swings.50s_plus: no deduction (a swing is a GE)

eg.IV: acrobatic or jump with at least one turn

composition_requirements.replaces: the condensed element groups (EG I-IV, +0.5 each), retired

cr.I: bar change (a jump LB to HB counts)
cr.II: kip, as mount or in the routine
cr.III: two different circle elements (WG circles, or an ME circle element such as the mill circle)
cr.IV: 180° long-axis turn (mount or dismount may fill it) or a flight element (a mount counts; a jump from standing on the LB to the HB does not)

UB.setting: any width; higher for tall gymnasts on request; one extra 10 cm mat for the dismount

cr.I: dance combination of two different dance elements, one a leap or jump with 180° split or straddle (50+: 135°; Table 2, 60+: 90°; from 60 jumps without split allowed)
cr.III: acrobatic or mixed combination (same acro may repeat, valued once; two different acro also fill CR IV; mount may be part; Table 2, 60+: a hold instead)
cr.IV: second different acrobatic element, a WG group 4 element, or an ME or GE that is an acrobatic or hold element (Table 2, 60+: a second different hold); rolls are acrobatic

situations.table_1: the host provides a 20 cm hard-top widening: gymnasts 40+ choose; only those without it get the beam bonus
situations.table_2: no widening (Tokyo 2027): everyone uses the beam and every gymnast 40+ gets the beam bonus

BB.composition: whole beam, across and along, at least two body positions; no dance or acro minimum

cr.I: dance passage with a 180° split leap (60+: 135°), WG take-off and landing rules
cr.II: acrobatic combination with at least one flight element (the same element twice is fine; 60+: an acro element with a gymnastic element)
cr.III: acrobatic element forward or sideward (arabians forward)
cr.V: dismount: the last acro element of a line, or one shown alone after the last line

equipment.mats_under_apparatus: allowed (beam included), placed before the routine, not moved
equipment.floor_mats: any number of 5 or 10 cm soft mats; no take-off from 8 in. mats; WAG may remove one, never move it
